fixed_research_goal: DRL trained on large complex10x10 parent scenes, frozen policy for variable4x3/6x6/8x8 local tasks, complete constraint-validated execution paths; supervision only auxiliary init/control
mandatory_pre_optimizer_binding: A separate execution task must hash the completed training runner and endpoint-adapted Fixed3/Detour baselines, verify conformance and S0 pass, then write execution receipt. No optimizer is authorized by S0 implementation task.

S1.role: bounded auxiliary supervised initialization, NOT final method
S1.instances: Exactly seeds.json S1_teachers256 specs from S2 training bank; endpoint-adaptedDetour16 followed by sameH, no selection using S3
S1.architecture: same GlobalLocalPolicy as S2 and all controls
S1.teacher: new endpoint-adapted Fixed3/Detour16 routes with same F&A/global nav/H; never import R1/T1 g0 action labels
S1.save: untrained checkpoint, frozen supervised checkpoint, every teacher instance and resource

S2.core: genuine policy-gradient optimization on large complex parent scenes
S2.episodes: 50% full10x10 tasks,50% local windows balanced4x3/6x6/8x8, all embedded in original10x10 geometry/navigation
S2.task_and_constraints: Sample declared parent/task bank only, A_condition=(parent_index+task_draw_index)%3 using frozen make_allow; unchanged proxy F and base footprint. Whole-parent task density/obstacles/F&A remain visible.
S2.windows_and_endpoints: Full episodes closed depot; local size cyclic4x3/6x6/8x8, x0/y0 uniformly drawn among valid table-grid origins from sampling RNG. Alternate closed depot and open first/last depot-connected global candidates by local episode index.
S2.schedule: even update indexes full; odd local sizes cyclic; four parent/task draws from fixed sampling seed; same instance3 trajectories: one fully policy-sampled including first action plus2 forced distinct legal first stops
S2.starts: Primary trajectory samples first action with logprob; auxiliary forced starts are first/last legal original IDs and contribute no forced-first logprob. All complete same target tasks; no TSP symmetry claim.
S2.loss: For each trajectory use detached leave-one-out mean return of the other2 as baseline. Negative advantage*logprob: primary weight1, each forced auxiliary weight.25, divide total by1.5. S0 forced-only probe checks plumbing, not this future optimizer.
S2.objective: REINFORCE on negative complete JH with exact masks and explicit entry/exit; no teacher action-regression substitute
S2.optimizer: Adam1e-4,clip1,512 fixed updates,batch4instances,3 optimizer seeds11622026..28; save fixed end, no S3 selection
S2.controls: frozen supervised start, untrained same architecture, continued-SL512updates on same frozen S1 dataset; all same F&A and postprocessing
S2.development: 18 declared local cases on3 separate parent layouts, checked at updates256 and512 for feasibility/resources only; no best-checkpoint selection and no S3 reads
S2.missing_reward: Failures charged; do not silently discard/reward-zero infeasible routes; stop incomplete. No new seed/epoch rescue.
S2.boundary: Training and controls remain supervised+RL distinction; final contribution requires positive independent RL increment, not merely smaller degradation.

S3.checkpoint: frozen fixed512-step endpoints, no local retraining
S3.inference: One deterministic greedy constructive trajectory per neural method, no multi-start/teacher/search in action selection. Raw and H results refer to the same raw construction; H benefit and added time separate.
S3.allow_mask: seeds.json S3 explicit A_condition=case%3 using same frozen make_allow formula
S3.groups: Seen-layout/new-task results and unseen-layout/new-task results separate; seen is not unseen-environment generalization.
S3.endpoints: corner closed-depot; center open connected endpoints; separate strata
S3.timing: 3 repeats, cold global-navigation and hot known-parent navigation; include parsing/prep/subset/all features/global encode/local decisions/H/export/independent validation; model load and parent caches explicit. All methods receive equal input/cache scope.
S3.cache: Hot cache primes navigation only; global/local neural embeddings rebuilt per request and bound to task+F+A+model. Report any later cache optimization separately, never reuse task-conditioned hG by map key alone.
S3.independent_RL_gate: ALL valid; vs frozen SL and continued-SL mean paired gain>=.5% with parent-cluster bootstrap95 lower>0, each size reported; three optimizer seeds direction consistent; no use of action Top1 as final success
S3.deployment_gate: vs Detour16 mean relative degradation one-sided95upper<=.5%; complete median time ratio<=.7 and p95<=1 in both cache modes; not dominated byFixed3; report seen/unseen and each size separately
S3.bootstrap: 20000 parent-cluster resamples seed11632026; independent parents6 seen/12 unseen, NOT108 independent environments
S3.no_blending: Report raw/H gains separately, no teacher search at inference, no returned-home/exit connection cost omission
